## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Include:
- API changes (if any)
- Configuration changes (if any)
- Database schema changes (if any)
- New dependencies (if any)

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Impact Analysis

### Breaking Changes
- [ ] This introduces breaking changes to the public API
- [ ] This introduces breaking changes to event schemas
- [ ] This introduces breaking changes to rule language
- [ ] This introduces breaking changes to SDKs
- [ ] This requires database migrations
- [ ] This changes deployment topology

### Compatibility
- [ ] Backward compatible
- [ ] Forward compatible
- [ ] Requires coordinated rollout

## Implementation Plan

If you have an implementation in mind, describe:
1. Files/packages that need to change
2. New interfaces or types needed
3. Test strategy
4. Migration strategy (if applicable)

## Related Issues/PRs

Link any related issues or pull requests.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have read the [Engineering Standards](../AGENTS.md)
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's architecture and principles
